events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The iconic frontman turns 54 today, still bringing the rock and roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since John Lennon released his timeless anthem of peace and hope, 'Imagine'. Still as powerful today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped, completely revolutionising how we listened to music. Did you have one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Tell us, what's your favourite 007 theme tune? From Bassey to Billie Eilish, there's some absolute classics.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today, a true visionary whose music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, a titan of British comedy. What's your favourite of his iconic roles?

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track is your absolute standout?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: It marks 35 years since the world lost Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His legacy continues to ignite stages and hearts worldwide.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal moment in pop history. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: It marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since the world lost a musical legend and peace advocate. His impact remains immeasurable.
